result.stdout:
IoCTools CLI
Usage:
  dotnet ioc-tools fields --project <csproj> --file <cs-file> [--type Namespace.Service] [--source]
  dotnet ioc-tools fields-path --project <csproj> --file <cs-file> --type Namespace.Service [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools services --project <csproj> [--output <dir>] [--source] [--type Namespace.Service]
  dotnet ioc-tools services-path --project <csproj> [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools explain --project <csproj> --type Namespace.Service
  dotnet ioc-tools graph --project <csproj> [--type Namespace.Service] [--format json|puml|mermaid] [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools why --project <csproj> --type Namespace.Service --dependency Fully.Qualified.Type
  dotnet ioc-tools doctor --project <csproj> [--fixable-only]
  dotnet ioc-tools compare --project <csproj> --output <dir> [--baseline <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools profile --project <csproj> [--type Namespace.Service]
  dotnet ioc-tools config-audit --project <csproj> [--settings appsettings.json]
  dotnet ioc-tools evidence --project <csproj> [--type Namespace.Service] [--settings appsettings.json] [--baseline <dir>] [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools suppress --project <csproj> [--severity warning,info] [--codes IOC035,IOC053] [--live] [--output .editorconfig]
  dotnet ioc-tools validators --project <csproj> [--filter ModelType]
  dotnet ioc-tools validator-graph --project <csproj> [--why ValidatorName]

Common switches:
  --configuration <Debug|Release>    Build configuration (default Debug)
  --framework <tfm>                   Target framework override if multi-targeting
  --source, -s                        Output generated source code instead of summary
  --type, -t <Namespace.Service>      Filter output to specific type (with --source)

  dotnet ioc-tools fields --project <csproj> --file <cs-file> [--type Namespace.Service] [--source]
  dotnet ioc-tools fields-path --project <csproj> --file <cs-file> --type Namespace.Service [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools services --project <csproj> [--output <dir>] [--source] [--type Namespace.Service]
  dotnet ioc-tools services-path --project <csproj> [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools explain --project <csproj> --type Namespace.Service
  dotnet ioc-tools graph --project <csproj> [--type Namespace.Service] [--format json|puml|mermaid] [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools why --project <csproj> --type Namespace.Service --dependency Fully.Qualified.Type
  dotnet ioc-tools doctor --project <csproj> [--fixable-only]
  dotnet ioc-tools compare --project <csproj> --output <dir> [--baseline <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools profile --project <csproj> [--type Namespace.Service]
  dotnet ioc-tools config-audit --project <csproj> [--settings appsettings.json]
  dotnet ioc-tools evidence --project <csproj> [--type Namespace.Service] [--settings appsettings.json] [--baseline <dir>] [--output <dir>]
  dotnet ioc-tools suppress --project <csproj> [--severity warning,info] [--codes IOC035,IOC053] [--live] [--output .editorconfig]
  dotnet ioc-tools validators --project <csproj> [--filter ModelType]
  dotnet ioc-tools validator-graph --project <csproj> [--why ValidatorName]

Common switches:
  --configuration <Debug|Release>    Build configuration (default Debug)
  --framework <tfm>                   Target framework override if multi-targeting
  --source, -s                        Output generated source code instead of summary
  --type, -t <Namespace.Service>      Filter output to specific type (with --source)
